lines.zh: 我在深水里划开一道长长的痕。
lines.en: I cut a long scar through the deep water.

lines.zh: 洋流推我向前，我顺着它走。
lines.en: The current pushes me on, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我的鳍扫过海草，草伏下去。
lines.en: My fin sweeps the seagrass, and it bends flat.

lines.zh: 水压在我身上，我走得很稳。
lines.en: The water presses on me, and I move steadily.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁壁滑，影子和岩石一样。
lines.en: I glide along the reef wall, my shadow like stone.

lines.zh: 鱼群散开，我从中间穿过去。
lines.en: The school scatters, and I pass through the middle.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过海底的沙。
lines.en: I press across the seabed sand, step by step.

lines.zh: 水下的路很暗，我不用看。
lines.en: The underwater path is dark; I do not need to look.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，可这片海不大。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but this sea is not large.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍一拍，水推着我走。
lines.en: One beat of my tail, and the water carries me.

lines.zh: 我绕过沉船，木头上长满苔。
lines.en: I round a wreck whose timbers are thick with moss.

lines.zh: 我从深处上来，水变暖了。
lines.en: I rise from the deep, and the water turns warm.

lines.zh: 涛声在头顶，我在下面跟着走。
lines.en: The surf sounds overhead, and I follow beneath it.

lines.zh: 我沿着暗流，一直走到浅处。
lines.en: I follow the undertow all the way into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我顺着海沟往更深处走。
lines.en: I follow the trench deeper.

lines.zh: 水堵住耳朵，我照样听得见。
lines.en: Water fills my ears; I still hear.

lines.zh: 我不沉也不浮，就停在这层水里。
lines.en: I neither sink nor rise; I hold this layer of water.

lines.zh: 鱼在我身边绕，不敢靠太近。
lines.en: Fish circle me, none of them coming close.

lines.zh: 我沉在礁石背后，只露出背鳍。
lines.en: I sink behind the reef with only my dorsal fin showing.

lines.zh: 海底的沙慢慢落回原处。
lines.en: The seabed sand settles back into place.

lines.zh: 我试了试牙，又慢慢收回去。
lines.en: I test my teeth against the water, then draw them back.

lines.zh: 深处有声音传上来，很闷。
lines.en: A sound rises from below, muffled.

lines.zh: 我伏着，身上落了一层细沙。
lines.en: I lie still, and a fine layer of sand settles on me.

lines.zh: 水流过我的鳃，一下又一下。
lines.en: Water passes my gills, again and again.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水转方向。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to turn.

lines.zh: 这片海静得让我不耐烦。
lines.en: This sea is so still it makes me restless.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁壁，像一块活着的石头。
lines.en: I press to the reef like a living stone.

lines.zh: 一条鳗鱼钻进石缝，我没追。
lines.en: An eel slips into a crack, and I let it go.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆动尾鳍，保持原位。
lines.en: I work my tail slowly, holding my place.

lines.zh: 头顶的光一晃，我抬起头。
lines.en: The light above wavers, and I look up.

lines.zh: 我把半个头探出水面看你。
lines.en: I push half my head above the surface to look at you.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我先浮上来一点。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, and I rise a little.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛对着你的方向。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed in your direction.

lines.zh: 我在水下看你，你未必看得见我。
lines.en: I watch you underwater; you may not see me.

lines.zh: 你涉水进来，我的鳍停住了。
lines.en: You wade in, and my fin goes still.

lines.zh: 我歪过头，量你有多高。
lines.en: I tilt my head and measure your height.

lines.zh: 水面下有一双眼睛在看你。
lines.en: A pair of eyes is watching you beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 你回头，我已经潜下去了。
lines.en: You turn, and I have already gone under.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍露出水面，给你看。
lines.en: I raise my dorsal fin above the surface for you.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝泡在水里，我先量这个。
lines.en: Your ankles are in the water; those I measure first.

lines.zh: 你这一下，连我的鳞都没破。
lines.en: That blow did not even crack a scale.

lines.zh: 我拉开距离，绕半圈再逼近。
lines.en: I open the distance, swing half around, then close again.

lines.zh: 我的血在水里拉出一条淡红。
lines.en: My blood draws a pale red thread through the water.

lines.zh: 疼得我甩了一下尾。
lines.en: The pain makes my tail lash once.

lines.zh: 你打中了我旧伤的旁边。
lines.en: You struck beside an old wound.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，装作走了。
lines.en: I sink and pretend to leave.

lines.zh: 六十六颗心，也不是打不烂。
lines.en: Sixty-six hearts are not unbreakable.

lines.zh: 这一道口子，我记你身上。
lines.en: I will hold this gash against you.

lines.zh: 水把我的血冲淡了。
lines.en: The water thins my blood away.

lines.zh: 我喘了一口气，水从鳃里出去。
lines.en: I heave a breath, and water passes out my gills.

lines.zh: 你的诱饵在水面晃，我不上去。
lines.en: Your bait bobs on the surface; I do not rise for it.

lines.zh: 我在深水里吃饱了，不稀罕。
lines.en: I have fed in the deep and do not care for it.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西太小，塞不住我的牙。
lines.en: That morsel is too small to fill my teeth.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，转身游开。
lines.en: I sniff at it and turn away.

lines.zh: 鱼比你的手更有意思。
lines.en: Fish are more interesting than your hand.

lines.zh: 你把网撒下来，我懒得理。
lines.en: You cast a net, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 那点血味引我，可我先看你。
lines.en: That trace of blood draws me, but I look at you first.

lines.zh: 我不追饵，我追撒饵的人。
lines.en: I do not chase bait; I chase the one who casts it.

lines.zh: 你把鱼扔进水里，我让它沉。
lines.en: You throw a fish in, and I let it sink.

lines.zh: 水里的东西，我自己会找。
lines.en: What I eat in the water, I find myself.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞上来，我的鳞都没退。
lines.en: You slam into me, and not one scale gives.

lines.zh: 我不躲，水替我挡了一半。
lines.en: I do not dodge; the water takes half the blow.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去更沉。
lines.en: My body is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 你顶过来，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: You shove, and I do not shift.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水翻了个圈。
lines.en: We collide, and the water turns a full circle.

lines.zh: 你踩在我的背上，滑了下去。
lines.en: You step on my back and slide off.

lines.zh: 我的鳞刮过你的腿。
lines.en: My scales rake across your leg.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我从礁边推开。
lines.en: That knock pushes me off the reef edge.

lines.zh: 你挡在水道口，我硬挤过去。
lines.en: You block the channel mouth, and I force through.

lines.zh: 我擦过你的腰，像一艘船。
lines.en: I brush your waist like a passing hull.

lines.zh: 这一片海，只有我这样的身量。
lines.en: In this sea, only I have a body this size.

lines.zh: 深处还有另一个影子在游。
lines.en: Another shadow swims in the deep.

lines.zh: 我们隔着很远的地方互相听。
lines.en: We listen to each other across a great distance.

lines.zh: 到了季节，水会变得很吵。
lines.en: In season, the water grows loud.

lines.zh: 我把卵留在礁石缝里，就走了。
lines.en: I leave my eggs in a reef crack and go.

lines.zh: 我不认伴侣，只认水道。
lines.en: I know no mate, only the channels.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼游过来，我让开了。
lines.en: A big fish swam over, and I gave way.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，只看谁更大。
lines.en: When my kind meet, we only ask who is larger.

lines.zh: 我身上有旧伤，是争来的。
lines.en: These old scars on me were earned in contests.

lines.zh: 深海里的伴，不是天天见。
lines.en: A companion of the deep is not seen every day.

lines.zh: 沉船里的东西，我一件不拿。
lines.en: I take nothing from the wreck.

lines.zh: 我死后什么也不留，海会收走。
lines.en: When I die I leave nothing; the sea takes it.

lines.zh: 一枚锚沉下来，我没碰。
lines.en: An anchor sinks past, and I do not touch it.

lines.zh: 沙子从我的鳍边漏过去。
lines.en: Sand slips away past my fins.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的骨头踢进石缝。
lines.en: I kick a fallen bone into a crevice.

lines.zh: 我不要你的东西，我要你。
lines.en: I do not want your things; I want you.

lines.zh: 海底的东西都归海底。
lines.en: What lies on the seabed belongs to the seabed.

lines.zh: 我什么都不带，游得才快。
lines.en: I carry nothing, and that is why I swim fast.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑沉到底，我没捡。
lines.en: Your dropped sword sinks; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只有牙，没有口袋。
lines.en: My mouth holds teeth, not pockets.

lines.zh: 你下水的那一刻，我就知道了。
lines.en: The moment you entered the water, I knew.

lines.zh: 水面动了一下，我停住。
lines.en: The surface stirs, and I stop.

lines.zh: 你在岸上的脚步，水底听得清楚。
lines.en: Down here, your footsteps on the bank come through clearly.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，往上游。
lines.en: I smell blood and swim upward.

lines.zh: 这片水域来了个不该来的。
lines.en: Something that does not belong has entered these waters.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，正对着你的影子。
lines.en: I raise my head square to your shadow.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被踩乱，我顺着找。
lines.en: The seabed sand is churned; I follow it.

lines.zh: 鱼会散，你不会；这就是差别。
lines.en: Fish scatter; you do not. That is the difference.

lines.zh: 我把目标定在你身上。
lines.en: I have set my target on you.

lines.zh: 潮水把你送到我面前。
lines.en: The tide has delivered you in front of me.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石绕，每转一圈就少一段距离。
lines.en: I circle the reef, and every turn shortens the gap.

lines.zh: 你往岸上走，我跟着。
lines.en: You head for shore, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍划开水面。
lines.en: My dorsal fin cuts the surface.

lines.zh: 我在深处等，等你再迈一步。
lines.en: I wait below for you to take one more step.

lines.zh: 水越来越浅，我的身体显得更大。
lines.en: The water shallows, and my body seems to grow.

lines.zh: 你没有发现我，我已经到了。
lines.en: You have not noticed me, and I am already here.

lines.zh: 我停住，让水把我推近。
lines.en: I hold still and let the water push me closer.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底绕，礁石替我挡。
lines.en: I circle along the seabed; the reef covers me.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我只要一冲。
lines.en: At this distance, I need only one rush.

lines.zh: 我把你困在两块石头之间。
lines.en: I have you boxed between two stones.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上去，你整个人飞了。
lines.en: I ram you head-on, and you fly.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬住你的肩。
lines.en: My teeth close on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你拖进水里。
lines.en: I whip my head and drag you into the water.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我用了全身的力气。
lines.en: That blow took all the strength I have.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑，你在里面乱抓。
lines.en: The water muddies, and you thrash inside it.

lines.zh: 我压着你，往深处坠。
lines.en: I bear down on you and sink toward the deep.

lines.zh: 你的骨头在我牙下响了一声。
lines.en: Your bone gives a crack under my teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬完就松开，看你沉。
lines.en: I bite, release, and watch you sink.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，你膝盖磕在礁石上。
lines.en: One lash of my tail sends your knee into the reef.

lines.zh: 你打我，我只晃了一下。
lines.en: You hit me, and I merely sway.

lines.zh: 深水翻涌，我从里面升上来。
lines.en: The deep churns, and I rise out of it.

lines.zh: 这一片海，换了个大东西住。
lines.en: Something large has taken up residence in this sea.

lines.zh: 我浮上来时，水面裂成两半。
lines.en: When I surface, the water splits in two.

lines.zh: 我第一次呼吸，带起一股腥味。
lines.en: My first breath drags up a reek of brine.

lines.zh: 浪退下去时，我已经搁在礁石边。
lines.en: When the wave pulls back, I am already grounded on the reef.

lines.zh: 我从暗处出来，海安静了。
lines.en: I come out of the dark, and the sea goes quiet.

lines.zh: 六十六颗心的重量压在水里。
lines.en: The weight of sixty-six hearts presses on the water.

lines.zh: 我一出现，鱼群就散了。
lines.en: The fish scatter the moment I appear.

lines.zh: 海底多了一道很长的影子。
lines.en: A very long shadow has joined the seabed.

lines.zh: 我来了，这片水就归我。
lines.en: I am here, and this water is mine.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的背鳍焦了。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface, and my dorsal fin is scorched.

lines.zh: 我从礁顶摔下去，砸起一片水。
lines.en: I fall off the reef top and smash up a sheet of water.

lines.zh: 水灌满我的鳃，我却上不去。
lines.en: Water fills my gills, and I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从水里掀起来，又摔回去。
lines.en: The blast lifts me out of the water and slams me back.

lines.zh: 一支弩箭钉在我背鳍上。
lines.en: A crossbow bolt lodges in my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 那道紫光穿过水，我的鳞片发麻。
lines.en: The violet light pierces the water and numbs my scales.

lines.zh: 我饿得太久，游起来发飘。
lines.en: I have gone hungry too long, and my swimming drifts.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水面劈下来，我全身都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the water and stiffens my whole body.

lines.zh: 水退干净了，我在干地上动不了。
lines.en: The water is gone, and I cannot move on dry ground.
